name: operations.fx_settlement_demands

list.description: Read native FX settlement demands within explicit value dates.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Native value-date upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD; ordered date difference must not exceed 31 days.

parameters.name: inst-id
parameters.description: Native entity identifier, without ownership inference; exact local filter after complete acquisition; OR within this selector, AND across selectors.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Native currency string; exact local filter after complete acquisition; OR within this selector, AND across selectors.

parameters.name: account-alias
parameters.description: Native settlement account alias; exact local filter after complete acquisition; OR within this selector, AND across selectors.

parameters.name: counterparty
parameters.description: Native counterparty string; exact local filter after complete acquisition; OR within this selector, AND across selectors.

parameters.name: sub-biz-type
parameters.description: Native sub-business type; exact local filter after complete acquisition; OR within this selector, AND across selectors.

summary: FX settlement demands for explicit value dates.
purpose: Inspect native settlement demands, amounts, directions and settlement references without executing settlement.

fields.name: valueDate
fields.meaning: Native YYYYMMDD value date, preserved unchanged.

fields.name: amount
fields.meaning: Native amount, without scaling or inferred sign.

fields.name: transNo
fields.meaning: Native settlement reference; not an FX trade identity.

fields.name: instId
fields.meaning: Native entity identifier, without ownership inference.

fields.name: direction
fields.meaning: Native debit/credit indicator; does not imply a locally calculated amount sign.

fields.name: memo
fields.meaning: Native settlement memo, with blanks preserved.

identity_description: Native positive integer settlement-demand id, independently qualified from transNo.
limitations: Explicit ordered YYYY-MM-DD value dates; date difference at most 31 days.
Only one width-5000 response is qualified. Scopes requiring another page fail the existing SDK request budget; no truncation or guessed pagination recovery.
Native ordering can vary across acquisitions. Preserve each response order, all native fields and exact amounts; no trade/rule lookup, sign inference or amount scaling.

sync.evidence: Native positive integer settlement-demand id, independently qualified from transNo. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
